description: This Java source file defines the OrderTypeValidator class, which implements validation logic for OrderType objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. The validator checks for null inputs, duplicate names, valid parent-child relationships, and proper field lengths, ensuring data integrity before saving or updating an OrderType.
